name: South Dakota

agency.name: South Dakota Department of Agriculture and Natural Resources, Minerals, Mining and Superfund Program (Oil and Gas), Rapid City; well database kept with the SD Geological Survey

form.name: Form 2: Application for Permit to Drill
form.notes: One-page form read (the 2023 flattened copy; the page also offers a 4-1-2026 fillable edition whose link answered 404 on my one try, so edition differences are unchecked). Fields: type of work (drill new, reenter, directional, other), type of well (oil, gas, injection, other), operator, surface owner, drilling contractor and rig, surface location with footages and optional lat/lon, directional top of pay and bottom hole, spacing unit acres and description, well name and number, elevation, field and pool, proposed depth and formation, casing and cement table, proposed operations text, pit liner, office-use permit no., API no., date issued. Filed with Form 1 (organization report), Form 3 (bond), Forms 8, 9 and 13, none read.

api_number.n: 'API Number' in Wells.xlsx; 'API No.' is an office-use box on Form 2

permit_number.n: 'Permit' in Wells.xlsx; 'Permit No.' office-use box on Form 2

well_name.n: 'Well Name' in Wells.xlsx; Form 2 asks well name and number

lease_name.n: Form 2 has no lease-name field (describes the spacing unit instead)

operator_name.n: 'Operator' in Wells.xlsx; Form 2 asks operator name and address

operator_id.n: Form 2 asks name and address only; Form 1 Organization Report not read

operator_type.n: Not on Form 2; Form 1 Organization Report not read

bond.n: Form 3 plugging and performance bond ($50,000 well, $100,000 multiple) goes with the application

county.n: 'County' in Wells.xlsx; also in Form 2's surface location

district.n: No district or region on Form 2 or in the files

field_pool.n: 'Oil or Gas Field' and 'Enhanced Recovery Unit'; Form 2 asks field and pool or wildcat

surface_latlon.n: Latitude and Longitude (GCS NAD 83) in Wells.xlsx; Form 2 asks them 'if available'

bottom_hole_loc.n: Well_Completions 'Bottom Hole Location Description' (after completion); Form 2: directional wells

lateral_path.n: Form 2 asks only top of pay and bottom hole for directional wells, no survey

elevation.n: 'Kelly Bushing Elevation' and 'Ground Surface Elevation' in Wells.xlsx; Form 2 asks elevation

surface_owner.n: Form 2: name and address of surface owner; Forms 8 and 9 (inspect, notice) not read

well_type.n: 'Permitted Well Type' and 'Current Well Type' in Wells.xlsx; Form 2: oil, gas, injection, other

work_type.n: Form 2: drill new well, reenter well, drill directional well, other; not in the files

well_direction.n: 'Wellbore Type' in Well_Completions; 'Oil-Horizontal' in Permitted Well Type

proposed_depth_md.n: Form 2 'Proposed Depth and Formation' (MD or TVD not stated); files hold actual depths

proposed_depth_tvd.n: Form's proposed depth does not say TVD; completions file has actual TVD only after drilling

target_formation.n: 'Bottom Hole Formation' and 'Producing Formation' (actual); Form 2 asks proposed formation

formation_tops.n: Formation_Tops.xlsx: picked tops per well (actual, not expected tops at permit time)

casing_program.n: Form 2 table: hole size, casing size, weight, depth (4 strings)

cement_program.n: Form 2: cementing program (amount, type, yield, additives) and top of cement

pressure_control.n: No BOP or pressure-control item on Form 2

water.n: No water source or volume item on Form 2

fracture_plan.n: No frac item on Form 2; only a free-text 'proposed operations' box

frac_dates.n: Rule 74:12:02:19: the fracture date is posted to FracFocus; a Sundry Notice also reports it; no agency data

frac_chemicals.n: Required through FracFocus (rule 74:12:02:19), trade secrets excepted; the agency's own data holds none

frac_additives.n: Required through FracFocus: trade name, supplier and purpose of each additive; the agency's own data holds none

frac_amounts.n: Required through FracFocus: maximum concentration in each additive and in the fluid; agency data holds none

spacing_unit.n: Form 2: acres in spacing (drilling) unit and its description

mineral_owner.n: Not on Form 2; Forms 9 (notification) and 13 (certification) not read

fee.n: Not on Form 2; fee amount not verified

notice_hearing.n: Form 9 certificate of notification is submitted with the application; form not read

date_received.n: Form 2 office-use box has approved by, permit no., API no., date issued; no date received

date_approved.n: 'Date Permit Issued' in Wells.xlsx (newest 2024-07-16); 'Date Issued' on Form 2

date_expires.n: Status key mentions expired permits and extensions; no expiry date column

status.n: 'Administrative Status' (Producing, Never drilled, Plugged and Abandoned, Shut In...)

plat_image.n: 'Permit file URL' is a scan of the permit; whether it holds the plat is unknown

form_image.n: 'Permit file URL' in Wells.xlsx: scanned image of the permit, filled for every row

completion_report.n: Well_Completions.xlsx holds completion data (depths, intervals); report image not verified

production_link.n: Oil_Gas_Production_All_Years.xlsx: monthly production by well, keyed by API_No

grade_reason: A free, reachable 18 MB zip (modified 2026-10-20, no login) holds Wells.xlsx with one row per well, 'Date Permit Issued', spud, completion and plug dates, permitted and current well type (incl. horizontal), county, field, footages and lat/lon, and production by API number. Monthly permit counts can be built and match the DANR page's yearly tables. Weak points: no work-type column (new drill versus re-entry exists only on Form 2), dates are Excel serials with a few placeholder years, and South Dakota is nearly dormant (1 permit in 2024, none dated after 2024-07-16 in the 2026-10-01 export).
producer_plan: Download SDOILexport.zip (about 18 MB; once a month is plenty), read Wells.xlsx (sheet Export__wells_Table_4_Web) with a standard-library reader, turn 'Date Permit Issued' (Excel serial days from 1899-12-30) into dates, drop pre-1950 placeholders, and count permits by month, split by 'Permitted Well Type' (Oil, Oil-Horizontal, Gas, Oil and Gas Exploration, Injection, Injection-Horizontal; four rows are blank). Spuds by month from 'Spud Date', completions from 'Completion Date', plugging from 'Plug Date', and status from 'Administrative Status'. County from 'County'. Join production by API (Oil_Gas_Production_All_Years.xlsx, 'Date_Production', 'Oil_bbls', 'Total_Gas_mcf'). Cross-check the permit counts against the yearly tables on the DANR Permits/Forms page. Caveats: no re-entry versus new-drill split; the export is a full replacement each time so earlier months can be revised; volumes are tiny, so show counts, not rates.
privacy_notes: Wells.xlsx and the DANR table name the operator of each well; some operators may be individuals, so publish names only for corporations, LLCs and partnerships. Form 2 asks the surface owner's name and address and the files link to scanned permits that may carry personal details; none of that is copied here.
